name: onboarder
description: Interactive architecture map of your workspace: endpoints → services → repositories → tables, cross-project links, AI summaries and chat. Analyzes the open folder in place — no upload.

onboarder.backendUrl.description: Attach to an already-running Onboarder backend (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8000). Leave empty to let the extension spawn its own.

onboarder.backendPath.description: Folder containing the Onboarder backend (the directory with pyproject.toml). Defaults to the backend/ folder next to this extension.

onboarder.frontendDist.description: Folder containing the built frontend (frontend/dist). Defaults to the frontend/dist next to this extension.

onboarder.startCommand.description: Command used to start the backend (run with backendPath as cwd). ${port} is replaced with a free port.

onboarder.autoReanalyze.description: Re-analyze the affected project automatically when you save a file (the open map refreshes in place).

scripts.package: npm run compile && npm run bundle-frontend && npx --yes @vscode/vsce package --allow-missing-repository
